fundamentals.name: Python
fundamentals.reason: High-frequency, versatile backend language useful for services, scripting and interviews.

fundamentals.name: JavaScript
fundamentals.reason: Foundational language for web development and required for frontend engineering roles.

fundamentals.name: HTML
fundamentals.reason: Essential markup language for building web pages and UIs.

fundamentals.name: CSS
fundamentals.reason: Core styling skills required to build usable, accessible interfaces.

fundamentals.name: Data Structures
fundamentals.reason: Fundamental for writing efficient code and passing technical interviews.

fundamentals.name: Algorithms
fundamentals.reason: Core for problem-solving and technical assessments in interviews.

fundamentals.name: Object-Oriented Programming
fundamentals.reason: Important paradigm for writing modular, maintainable code — applies across languages.

fundamentals.name: JSON
fundamentals.reason: Primary data interchange format for web APIs and frontend-backend integration.

frameworks_and_runtime.name: React
frameworks_and_runtime.reason: Most in-demand frontend framework; key for building production UIs and portfolio projects.

frameworks_and_runtime.name: TypeScript
frameworks_and_runtime.reason: Adds type safety to JS, widely used with React in production — improves code quality and employability.

databases.name: SQL
databases.reason: Fundamental for storing and querying relational data; expected knowledge for many roles.

version_control_and_ci_cd.name: Git
version_control_and_ci_cd.reason: Essential version control tool for collaboration and code management.

version_control_and_ci_cd.name: Github
version_control_and_ci_cd.reason: Primary platform for hosting projects and demonstrating work to employers; learn GitHub workflows.

version_control_and_ci_cd.name: CI/CD
version_control_and_ci_cd.reason: Fundamental for automated testing and deployments; basic pipelines boost productivity and resume strength.

testing_and_debugging.name: Software testing
testing_and_debugging.reason: General testing knowledge ensures product quality and is expected in teams.

testing_and_debugging.name: Unit Testing
testing_and_debugging.reason: Practice that catches regressions early; important for both frontend and backend codebases.

testing_and_debugging.name: Jest
testing_and_debugging.reason: Standard testing framework for JavaScript/React unit tests — practical to learn for frontend roles.

testing_and_debugging.name: Debugging
testing_and_debugging.reason: Essential daily skill for diagnosing and fixing issues quickly across stacks.

api_and_networking.name: REST
api_and_networking.reason: Most common API style; critical for frontend-backend integration and interview knowledge.

api_and_networking.name: APIs (general)
api_and_networking.reason: Understanding how to design, consume, and test APIs is vital for full-stack interactions.

api_and_networking.name: HTTP
api_and_networking.reason: Protocol fundamentals (status codes, headers, methods) are important for debugging and APIs.

deployment_and_cloud.name: Docker
deployment_and_cloud.reason: Containerization for consistent dev and deployment environments — widely used and practical to learn.

deployment_and_cloud.name: AWS (basics)
deployment_and_cloud.reason: Familiarity with core cloud concepts (S3, EC2, managed services) is valuable for deployments and interviews.

deployment_and_cloud.name: Linux (basics)
deployment_and_cloud.reason: Basic comfort with the Linux command line helps with servers, containers, and dev tooling.

architecture_and_design.name: Microservices (conceptual)
architecture_and_design.reason: High-level understanding of microservice architecture helps when integrating with backend teams; focus on concepts rather than full mastery.

architecture_and_design.name: Design principles (component design, SRP, SOLID)
architecture_and_design.reason: Crucial for building maintainable systems and for interview system-design discussions at a basic level.

data_and_ai_integration.name: Basic data handling and integration
data_and_ai_integration.reason: Being able to fetch, transform, and display data (from SQL/REST/JSON) is necessary for most roles.

security_and_scalability.name: Scalability & performance basics
security_and_scalability.reason: Understand caching, performance bottlenecks and client/server-side optimization at a high level.

security_and_scalability.name: Security basics (auth, CORS, OWASP top 10 awareness)
security_and_scalability.reason: Fundamental security knowledge that reduces common vulnerabilities and is often checked in interviews or code reviews.

communication.name: Communication
communication.reason: Clear written and verbal communication is essential for teamwork, interviews, and documenting work.

project_management.name: Agile (basic workflows)
project_management.reason: Understanding Agile rituals and how teams plan work is expected in most engineering environments.

project_management.name: Jira (basic)
project_management.reason: Common tool for tracking work in Agile teams; basic familiarity aids onboarding.

problem_solving.name: Problem-solving mindset / interview practice
problem_solving.reason: Regular practice with coding problems, system thinking, and explaining trade-offs is crucial to pass interviews.
